scenarios.title: A｜询问是谁吃的
scenarios.setting: 玩家打开冰箱，发现昨天买的蛋糕不见了。

turns.prompt: 你想询问冰箱里的食物是谁动过的，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, did you eat the cake that was in the fridge?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, did you eat the cake that was in the fridge?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Do you know what happened to the cake I left in the fridge?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know what happened to the cake I left in the fridge?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: This might sound random, but have you seen my cake?

feedback.naturalExpression: This might sound random, but have you seen my cake?
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: I had some cake in the fridge yesterday, and now it’s gone. Do you know anything about it?

feedback.naturalExpression: I had some cake in the fridge yesterday, and now it’s gone. Do you know anything about it?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: Who ate away my cake?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, did you eat the cake that was in the fridge?
feedback.explanation: 吃掉蛋糕直接说“ate my cake”，不必加“away”。

turns.prompt: 你想确认自己说的是哪份食物，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, the one in the box on the top shelf.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, the one in the box on the top shelf.
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

choices.text: Yeah. I was saving it for tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I was saving it for tonight.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: That’s the one. Did you have some?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s the one. Did you have some?
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

turns.text: Uh… yeah. I thought it was for both of us.

scenarios.title: B｜室友承认
scenarios.setting: 在“冰箱里的食物被吃了”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“室友承认”。

turns.text: Sorry. I ate it last night. I honestly thought you wouldn’t mind.

turns.prompt: 你想说明愿意分享，但这次另有安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: I don’t mind sharing sometimes, but I was saving that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t mind sharing sometimes, but I was saving that.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: Okay, but I wish you’d asked me first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, but I wish you’d asked me first.
feedback.explanation: “wish you’d asked me first”表达对没有事先询问的遗憾，把共用物品的边界说清楚。

choices.text: I bought that for myself, so I was pretty disappointed when it disappeared.

feedback.naturalExpression: I bought that for myself, so I was pretty disappointed when it disappeared.
feedback.explanation: 交代东西是买给自己的，再说明失落感，让对方理解未经询问拿走的影响。

choices.text: It’s not really about the cake. I’d just rather you didn’t take my food without asking.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s not really about the cake. I’d just rather you didn’t take my food without asking.
feedback.explanation: “not really”是较温和的否定，常表示不太符合或并不怎么做。

turns.text: I’m sorry. I’ll buy you another one.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I’d appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Okay. And next time, just ask me first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. And next time, just ask me first.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: Thanks. I don’t mind sharing if you check with me beforehand.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I don’t mind sharing if you check with me beforehand.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s okay. We’re good.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. We’re good.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: No worries. Just don’t eat the replacement too. 😂

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. Just don’t eat the replacement too. 😂
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

scenarios.title: C｜制定公共 / 私人物品规则
scenarios.setting: 两人发现不只是蛋糕，牛奶、鸡蛋、调料等东西也经常分不清是谁的。

turns.prompt: 关于「冰箱里的食物被吃了」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Maybe we should figure out which food we’re sharing and which food is personal.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we should figure out which food we’re sharing and which food is personal.
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。

choices.text: I think we need a better system for groceries.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we need a better system for groceries.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: How about we agree on what counts as shared food?

feedback.naturalExpression: How about we agree on what counts as shared food?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Maybe we could keep some things communal and keep everything else separate.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we could keep some things communal and keep everything else separate.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

turns.text: Yeah. Things like milk and eggs get confusing.

turns.prompt: 关于「冰箱里的食物被吃了」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: We could split the cost of basics like milk, eggs, and cooking oil.

feedback.naturalExpression: We could split the cost of basics like milk, eggs, and cooking oil.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Things we both use regularly can be shared.

feedback.naturalExpression: Things we both use regularly can be shared.
feedback.explanation: “can be shared”用被动结构说明可以共用，适合确认共同生活中的物品边界。

choices.text: And anything we buy specifically for ourselves should be off-limits unless we ask.

feedback.naturalExpression: And anything we buy specifically for ourselves should be off-limits unless we ask.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: Maybe we could each have our own shelf for personal food.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we could each have our own shelf for personal food.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

turns.text: Having separate shelves would probably be easiest.

turns.prompt: 关于「冰箱里的食物被吃了」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah. And we can keep shared stuff on the middle shelf.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. And we can keep shared stuff on the middle shelf.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: That works. Then we’ll know what’s okay to use.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works. Then we’ll know what’s okay to use.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Perfect. And if we’re not sure, we can just ask.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. And if we’re not sure, we can just ask.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.prompt: 你想轻松回应双方关于食物的约定，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Hopefully no more mysterious disappearing food.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Hopefully no more mysterious disappearing food.
feedback.explanation: “hopefully”表达希望事情朝某个方向发展，不等于保证结果。

choices.text: Perfect. Problem solved.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Problem solved.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。
